value.name: anticipates harder estate conflict
value.description: Asha realizes the most difficult part of the estate dispute is only beginning and will play out in the dining room rather than in her office or court.
evidence: the harder part of this estate was just beginning
the harder part would not be conducted in her office or in the courthouse on Filbert Street but in this dining room

value.name: expects repeated dining room visits
value.description: Asha recognizes she will end up spending more time in the dining room than she intended because of the family conflict.
evidence: she — Asha — would, against every rule she had set for herself about this case, be in that dining room more often than was strictly necessary

value.name: recalls matriarch's plea for kindness
value.description: Asha remembers the matriarch's February letter asking her children and housekeeper to be kind to one another in the room where she is gone.
evidence: because the matriarch had asked, in a letter written in February, for her children and her housekeeper to be kind to each other in the room where she was no longer standing

value.name: takes banker's box to call Halloran
value.description: Asha picks up the banker's box and goes to the front parlor to call Mr. Halloran.
evidence: She picked up the banker's box. She went into the front parlor to call Mr. Halloran.

value.name: hears family tension in dining room
value.description: As Asha leaves, she hears Rosa speak quietly in Spanish, Daniel answer, and Lucia begin crying, signaling rising tension among the family.
evidence: Behind her, in the dining room, she heard Rosa say something very quietly in Spanish, and she heard Daniel answer, and she heard Lucia begin, at last, to cry.

value.name: calls Halloran with codicil news
value.description: Mr. Halloran answers Asha's call, and she tells him she has found a codicil.
evidence: Mr. Halloran picked up on the second ring.

value.name: Halloran processes new information
value.description: Halloran pauses to absorb the news, showing the measured, intimidating style he is known for.
evidence: There was a pause on the line of the kind he was famous for
the sound of a man making space in his head for new information

value.name: identifies codicil witnesses
value.description: Asha begins explaining that the codicil was witnessed by Rosa Maldonado and Mrs. Inez Carra.
evidence: "By Rosa Maldonado, the housekeeper, and a Mrs. Inez Carra
